scope: WordPress posts archive metadata; canonical links can redirect or point outside /blog/, retained as API post records. Live inventory change disclosed.
index_read_scope: Canonical URL/title/publication date where available; article text not read by metadata crawler.
second_inventory_check: Metadata-only ID+link pagination; observed source IDs retained. No article body read.
metadata_enrichment_note: Title/date field extraction and canonical-URL check only; neither body reading nor technical verification.
inventory_change_note: Initial posts API advertised 5303 source records and produced 5276 distinct canonical links. ID-only recheck observed 5304 source records and 5277 distinct canonical links; a new front-page publication was reconciled. Public pagination is live, not an atomic historical snapshot.
date_coverage_note: Earliest known publication date is among indexed metadata with a usable published field; it does not infer unknown dates or convert sitemap lastmod into publication date.
not_an_archive_content_read: Archive endpoint traversal indexes metadata. Five selected articles are separately full-main-body reads; no historical article-body completeness claimed.
